defs.def: a person whose job is cutting up and selling meat in a shop/store or killing animals for this purpose 屠夫；肉贩

ex.s: Whether we are scientists, lawyers, doctors, public servants, consultants, clerks, receptionists or butchers, we all make our respective contributions.
ex.t: 无论我们是科学家、律师、医生、公务员、顾问、职员、接待员还是屠夫，我们都各自做出贡献。

ex.s: Last week, I went to the butcher's and asked "Do you have pigs'ears?""No,"the butcher said, pulling at his own ears,"just these ordinary ones."He must have thought I was joking.
ex.t: 上周，我去肉铺问：“你们有猪耳朵吗？”“没有，”肉贩拉着自己的耳朵说，“只有这些普通的。”他一定以为我在开玩笑。

ex.s: Here, hundreds of people from all walks of life, including butchers, hairdressers and government officials, can be seen going about their daily business.
ex.t: 在这里，可以看到数百名来自各行各业的人——包括屠夫、理发师和政府官员——都在各忙各的日常营生。

defs.def: a shop/store that sells meat 肉店；肉铺

ex.s: Butcher shops, greengrocers, bakeries, and cheese shops line the town square.
ex.t: 肉铺、果蔬店、面包店和奶酪店排列在小镇广场周围。

ex.s: Bakeries, fast-food joints, butcher shops, cafes, and restaurants everywhere provide some of the premier food experiences in the world.
ex.t: 各地的面包店、快餐店、肉铺、咖啡馆和餐厅，提供了世界上一些顶级的饮食体验。

defs.def: a person who kills people in a cruel and violent way 刽子手
to kill people in a very cruel and violent way 屠杀；杀戮
to kill animals and cut them up for use as meat 屠宰；宰杀
to spoil sth by doing it very badly 弄砸；糟蹋
